summary: CapyCapy: Journey to Mars is an educational ScratchJr animation created by elementary school students for the Space Video Game challenge. The story follows an astronaut floating in outer space who boards her spaceship, travels to Mars, and shares fun, accessible facts about the Red Planet—combining visual storytelling with NASA planetary science for young learners.
details:
What It Does:

CapyCapy: Journey to Mars is an animated space adventure built in ScratchJr designed to introduce young children to space travel and the planet Mars. The animation opens with an astronaut floating in outer space, who then enters her spacecraft, travels across space to land on Mars, and presents interesting facts about the Red Planet to the viewer.

How It Works & How We Built It:

Our elementary school team (grades 2–4) created this project using visual block programming in ScratchJr. We sequenced motion blocks to simulate zero-gravity floating, programmed character visibility and scene transitions so the astronaut smoothly boards the rocket and arrives on Mars, and added speech bubbles to share key planetary facts in a clear, engaging way.

Why It Matters:

Young learners absorb science best through characters and adventure. By pairing an astronaut's journey with real information about Mars, our project sparks curiosity about human spaceflight and helps kids learn about our neighboring planet without complex jargon.

Tools & Resources Used:

- ScratchJr for visual block coding, movement sequences, scene transitions, and dialogue

- Custom space and Mars backgrounds

- NASA Mars Exploration educational facts and planetary imagery
